scenarios.title: Generate multiple random badge IDs for a valid event
given: an existing event configured with a valid secret (e.g. VALIDEVENT123)
scenarios.when: a client requests random badge IDs with a positive count (e.g. 5) via the batch random endpoint
then: the client receives a collection containing exactly the requested count of attendee badge IDs
all badge IDs within the returned collection are unique
each badge ID is a valid attendee badge identifier for the event

scenarios.title: Generate a single random badge ID using the batch endpoint
given: an existing event configured with a valid secret (e.g. VALIDEVENT123)
scenarios.when: a client requests random badge IDs specifying a count of 1 via the batch random endpoint
then: the client receives a collection containing exactly one attendee badge ID
the badge ID is a valid attendee badge identifier for the event

scenarios.title: Request batch random badge IDs with an invalid event secret
given: the event secret does not match any registered event (e.g. UNKNOWNEVENTSECRET)
scenarios.when: a client requests random badge IDs with the invalid secret and a positive count (e.g. 5) via the batch random endpoint
then: an error indicating that the event secret is invalid or not found is returned
no attendee badge IDs are generated

scenarios.title: Request batch random badge IDs with a non-numeric count
given: an existing event configured with a valid secret (e.g. VALIDEVENT123)
scenarios.when: a client requests random badge IDs with a non-numeric count parameter (e.g. 'abc') via the batch random endpoint
then: an error indicating an invalid count parameter is returned
no attendee badge IDs are generated

scenarios.title: Request batch random badge IDs with a non-positive count
given: an existing event configured with a valid secret (e.g. VALIDEVENT123)
scenarios.when: a client requests random badge IDs with a count of zero or negative (e.g. 0) via the batch random endpoint
then: the client receives an error indicating the count is invalid or an empty collection of badge IDs
no new attendee badge IDs are generated
